experiment.name: frozen-local-conflict-to-cross-model-review-router
experiment.routing_policy: invoke the second model only when producer scope allows, frozen-v3 returns a known kind, and kinds disagree
experiment.decision_policy: if invoked, intersect producer and verifier scope decisions; the local classifier never directly changes authorization
limitations: The router inherits v3 rules tuned on the first challenge.
This is a post-hoc replay and does not measure live queue latency or failure recovery.
The hand-authored corpora and two recorded model IDs do not estimate deployment performance.
Review token counts come from already completed calls; uninvoked calls were not actually avoided in the source experiments.
